scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Authoritative hosted query returned 20 events, 49 contended guests in 50 preallocated capacity slots, and three native users.
Guest-context query returned the public event without privateHostNote and filtered the private event entirely.
Bob’s native principal performed maybe/no/yes plus-one transitions and every state settled authoritatively.
Alice saw host-only data, Bob read as guest and wrote only as cohost, and Mallory’s private read/write attempts were denied.
Bob’s existing native SSE subscription moved from 49 visible guests to zero after Alice atomically hid the event list and its invitation rows.
Two native actor transactions barrier-dispatched against one unique seat key; one authoritative row remained and total attendance was 50.
Bob’s second native SSE client observed the 20-post wall burst and RSVP total transition from 49 to 50.
Upload, authorized delivery, outsider denial, and metadata deletion passed; at least one signed delivery path remained usable after deletion, so complete deletion is not claimed.
scenarioResults.note: Upload, authorized delivery, outsider denial, and metadata deletion passed; at least one signed delivery path remained usable after deletion, so complete deletion is not claimed.
